name: aidenbradley/test-support-static-analysis-tooling
description: Isolated static-analysis tooling for aidenbradley/test-support, kept separate from the module's own composer.json so mglaman/phpstan-drupal's own PHP floor (8.1+) never affects the module's actual PHP >=7.3 runtime/test dependencies. See bin/install-static-analysis-tooling.php in the module root.
